title: Italian Crispy Savory Fritters
description: Crispy fried fritters filled with savory Italian flavors and spices, perfect as an appetizer or snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, parmesan, savory spices, garlic powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix well.
Using a spoon or a piping bag, drop small balls of the mixture onto a plate or tray.
Heat about 1-2 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, carefully add a few fritters to the oil, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters until they are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy!
